name: Encrypted Rune
summary: At Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin sends a coded message to young rogues in Coldridge Valley. Sten Stoutarm passes it to them, and the rune directs them indoors to meet their trainer.

sections.title: A Message in Code
sections.body: Sten Stoutarm gives the etched stone to rogues who help him in Coldridge Valley's snowy passes. He says someone slipped it to him for delivery and suspects Solm Hargrin sent it. The rune tests a novice's discretion and calls them inside, where Solm can meet them without announcing his need for scouts and scoundrels across the courtyard.

sections.title: Under Anvilmar's Rafters
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin welcomes the new rogues and offers to teach them the maneuvers, strikes, and subtle arts that keep them alive and earn them coin. He also reminds dwarf rogues to look after their displaced gnomish allies, who are still recovering from Gnomeregan's catastrophic fall.

faq.answer: Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer in Anvilmar's great hall, writes the rune and has Sten Stoutarm pass it discreetly to promising recruits in the snow.

faq.q: Where do I find Solm Hargrin?
faq.answer: Solm Hargrin is inside Anvilmar's main hall, the stone bastion at the center of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this rune?
faq.answer: The rune summons novice rogues to decode its message and report to their trainer, who offers to teach them combat techniques and survival maneuvers.

faq.q: Why does Solm mention the gnomes?
faq.answer: Gnomeregan has recently fallen to disaster, and gnomish refugees share Coldridge Valley and Anvilmar with the dwarves. Solm reminds his students that they need support as they settle into their temporary home.

faq.q: Who gives the rune to the player?
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm gives the stone to rogue adventurers in Coldridge Valley after they help him with local valley matters.

faq.q: Can other classes receive this rune?
faq.answer: No. The rune is for rogue initiates beginning their journeys in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a rogue, this rune brings you to Solm Hargrin, where he offers to teach you stealth, martial tricks, and survival skills in Dun Morogh.
As a dwarf of the Ironforge clan, you are welcomed by Solm into the shadows, where a cold blade and darkness help keep you alive in Dun Morogh.
As a gnome, you hear Solm urge his students to stand by the gnomes sheltering in Coldridge Valley after the tragic loss of their home in Gnomeregan.
